title: Sleep For The Dream Warden (Patreon Exclusive)
description:
Every night when you close your eyes, someone is waiting.

You have felt the pull before. That strange heaviness right before you drift off. It’s the sensation that something is reaching for you from the other side of waking, but you told yourself it was just your imagination. You were wrong.

The Dream Warden has been watching you for a long time, and tonight, she speaks directly into your sleeping mind.

This audio takes you deep into her realm. It conditions you to respond, plants suggestions that grow stronger every time you fall asleep, and it ensures that when you wake, a piece of her stays with you.

What happens in the dark hours belongs to her now.

🎤 Available for Personalization
author: Mistress Amethyst
